purpose: Keep Linkara world-map, region-scene, and BGM data organized before runtime wiring.
Make redraw and UI-fit decisions explicit before the map goes live.
Prepare stable scene-switching keys without changing save state or runtime code.

atlas.coordinateSource: Existing SVG placeholder coordinates from src/ui/atlasController.js

mobileRisk: Baked labels and paragraph copy will likely be too small on 390x844.
The image is portrait, but not tall enough for full mobile screen use without cropping or letterboxing.
Future UI should prefer overlay labels/buttons over relying on baked text.

recommendedVariants.recommendation: Create a cleaner 9:16 or scrollable mobile UI map variant with fewer baked labels and separate DOM/SVG region labels.
The current 1178x1280 image can be tested as a reference or large panel asset.
Keep the current file as the canonical visual reference until a UI-specific redraw is approved.

futureRuntimeRequirements: Add a scene profile for every region before using the region background as an active habitat.
Define background cover/crop behavior for 16:9 region art in the current mobile-first UI.
Route BGM through the existing audio manager with volume caps and fades.
Keep locked regions non-FOMO: no timers, red dots, daily tasks, or completion pressure.

regionBackgroundFit.currentHabitatReference: LakeNightCamp_v2 uses mobile-first vertical background art.
notes: These landscape scenes are useful for atlas previews, chapter selection, or wide scene cards.
Using them as full active habitat backgrounds on mobile will need cover/crop anchors or vertical redraws.
Companion placement, trace placement, celestial arcs, and UI-safe zones cannot be inferred from pixels alone.
